'''Choel Nyl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] war journalist who was presumed [[Death/Legends|dead]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], but was found to be living under a false name on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abhean/Legends|Abhean]].<ref name="printbroadcast">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Never Printed, Never Broadcast}}</ref>
